{{dablink|For other uses of the word "gray," see [[Gray]].}}
'''Gray fennel''' is a fast-acting herb used frequently by assassins. It was used by the [[Wisdom]], Malena, in [[Nynaeve]]'s testing to kill [[Bran al'Vere]], and also by those who tried to assassinate [[Elayne Trakand|Queen Elayne]]. Their knives were tipped with the deadly poison and powdered peach pit. Sadly, not much else is known about it other than the eyes and tongue of the victims are abnormal after death.
